mentions.name: Chaingenius
mentions.description: This project applies NLP and LLM techniques to create a geometry over the discrete space of Ethereum transaction execution structure, with the goal of finding on-chain structural anomalies and exploring whether clustering transactions by behavior yields emergent semantic properties.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on leveraging NLP and LLM techniques to create a geometry over the discrete space of Ethereum transaction execution structure. (sorry... it's a bit of a mouthful)

https://www.chaingenius.ai

The goal is to find on-chain structural anomalies, as well as seeing if clustering by behavior has emergent semantic properties
